correctness.rationale: For every n>=2 the linearly forbidden-11 overlap graph has F(n+2) arcs and is strongly connected. Adding each admissible 0u0 containing a one once balances the exact in/out degree formulas and yields a closed Euler walk. The initial-zero potential decreases by at most one on every arc and by exactly one on each specified duplicate; pairing any balanced extra flow with the original divergence gives >=F(n)-1 extra traversals. This is an infinite proof independent of the finite checker; check.py replay verified constructions/potentials for n=2..17 and exhaustive shorter cyclic candidates for n=2..5.

value.rationale: A natural forbidden-factor finite-type language lacks a classical perfect one-visit full linear-block cycle once imbalance appears. The theorem gives the exact shortest repair for every span, a complete constructive optimal window multiplicity profile, and a tight dual certificate useful for constrained-window coding and graph route-inspection test instances. It is not a bare table of finite values, routine substitution, or an unmotivated arbitrary cutoff.
